description: One revision of a write scenario (Task 28 design 4.1): one CREATE or UPDATE candidate of the latest discovery, the request shape, the fields to send, the READ checks to compare with, the side effect confirmations, the limits and the approval TTL (at most the defaults) and the reference to the input rules. The value lists and limits are owned by src/control/approval/scenario-contracts.ts; the draft rules against the candidate are checked by src/control/approval/scenario-policy.ts. The verification spec (Task 30 design 3, T30a: the success and input error conditions, the way to take the record id and the READ verification bound to the generated values) is required and each item is null while not specified; a scenario with an unspecified item can be approved but gets no execution grant. The UPDATE spec (Task 31 design 3, T31b: the CREATE scenario of the ledger, the path templates of the update form and of the action with {id} once as a whole segment, the fields to keep and the templated identity digest of the candidate) is required; it is null for a CREATE scenario and for an API scenario, and a spec for a FORM UPDATE scenario (LG-3: the revisions stored before the UPDATE spec, before the verification spec and the API UPDATE revisions stored before the contract of T41a are not read); the draft validation requires it for an UPDATE draft. No property holds an input value, a token, an option label or a credential. The state (DRAFT, APPROVED, REVOKED) is kept by the store, not in a revision. T38b (Task 38 design 3.2): the transport (absent or FORM for a form scenario as before; API for a scenario of the request of the page script) and the API spec of an API scenario (request is null; the field names are the keys of the body to send).

transport.description: T38b (Task 38 design 3.2): the way the scenario sends. Absent in a FORM scenario stored before (and written by the FORM drafts); FORM is also accepted. API: the request of the page script to an approved service origin; the request shape is in api and request is null.

maxCumulativeCreates.description: LZ-3c: a remnant kept so that the approval digest version does not change; not used by any judgement (no upper bound).

approvalTtlDays.description: LZ-3c: a remnant kept so that the approval digest version does not change; not used by any judgement (no upper bound).

allOf.description: T38b: an API scenario has the API spec, no request of a form and no UPDATE spec of a form.
PL-6a: an API scenario has no way to judge the result of a form (resultJudgement null when present) and takes the record id from the page (not the record id patterns of a form).
T38b: a FORM scenario (transport absent or FORM) has the request of a form and no API spec.

T38c: the READ verification of a FORM scenario binds at least one value (only an API scenario may have no binding, for a page path template READ; the rule against the READ check definition is checked by src/control/approval/scenario-policy.ts).
LG-3 (the test suite tiers design 3.7.2): a FORM UPDATE scenario has the UPDATE spec (not null).

LG-3 (the test suite tiers design 3.7.2): an API UPDATE scenario has the contract of T41a (the kept keys, the templated identity digest and the ledger). LU-6 (list row update design 5.4, fix round 1): an API UPDATE whose ledger has the list row has no templated identity digest (the list page path has no record id; the approval validity checks the candidate by its identity digest); every other API UPDATE has it, as before.

apiFieldType.description: T38R2-fix (Task 38 design 7, the last row; M-2): the input type of the field behind a key to send (SCENARIO_API_FIELD_TYPES of src/control/approval/scenario-contracts.ts).

positions.description: ARR-3 (DEF-234): only for a key whose value is an array of 2 or more elements. The role of each element in order: FIELD (the generated value of the field; exactly one) or an empty position (EMPTY_STRING for an empty text, EMPTY_NULL for null). A list of one element (the DEF-226 form) has no item. Never a value.

element.description: ARR-4 (DEF-234): only for the field at one position of an array with the values of two or more fields. The key of the array in the body and the position (the key of this item is the path key[i] of src/core/api-request-shape.ts). Never a value.

name.description: ARR-5 (DEF-234): the inner key of an object row (the key of this item is the path key[i].name).

rows.description: ARR-5 (DEF-234): only for the field at an inner key of an object row. The role of each inner key of each row in order (inner keys in name order; no limit of the rows and the inner keys since L13 fix round 1): FIELD or an empty position. Never a value.

api.description: T38b (Task 38 design 3.2, 7 history): the API spec of an API scenario, made from the shape of the submission probe (no value): the shape digest, the request shape, the keys to send with their input fields, the keys decided by the page (named at the approval; their values are not compared), the header names supplied by the page (the names supplied by the browser are left out), the filter name of an UPDATE, the way to take the record id (a key of the response body; null for the way of the verification spec) and the ledger of an UPDATE. The lists and limits are owned by src/control/approval/scenario-contracts.ts.

keptKeys.description: T41a (Task 41 design 3.1): the kept keys of an API UPDATE (the marked keys that are not changed; no generated value). Only an UPDATE has them.

field.description: T41a (Task 41 design 3.3, the user decision 2): the field of the update page for a key decided by the page of an API UPDATE.

elements.description: ARR-2 (DEF-226): only for a key decided by the page of an API CREATE whose value is an array. The set of the JSON types of the elements (scalar only) and the count (no limit since L13 fix round 1). Never a value.

templatedIdentityDigest.description: T41a (Task 41 design 3.1): the identity digest of the candidate with the last record id of the page path as {id} (an API UPDATE only).

otherFilterNames.description: DEF-198 (list row update design 5.9 2): the names of the other filters of an API UPDATE than the record id filter (a tenant filter and so on; in code unit order; one or more). Made from the probe shape by the draft check, never typed by a person. A spec without other filters has no item (no empty list). The values to compare are the values of the keys of the same names decided by the page at the registration of the same inspection (only in the write START; never in the scenario).

ledgerPageKeys.description: DEF-203 (list row update design 5.10 2): the names of the keys of the body of an API UPDATE that are not bound to a field of the update page (other than the keys of the filters) and are page keys of the ledger create too (in code unit order; one or more). Made from the probe shape and the ledger fact by the draft check, never typed by a person. A spec without such keys has no item (no empty list). The values to compare are the values of the keys of the same names decided by the page at the registration of the same inspection (only in the write START; never in the scenario).

listRow.description: LU-6 (list row update design 5.4 the 1): the way to choose the row of a list row update (optional; absent for the update of an update page as before): the list page path (no {id}; the page path of the candidate), the identity digest of the named opener in the row (the opener of the submission probe record) and the name of the field that chooses the row (a field of the ledger scenario whose value differs each run). No value of the row. The rules are checked by src/control/approval/scenario-policy.ts.

verification.description: PL-6a (plain UI design 8.1, the designer's decisions (a)-(c)): the way to judge the result (resultJudgement: FORM_STRUCTURE for a FORM scenario, null for an API scenario) replaced the success and the input error conditions that a person typed. The writer always writes resultJudgement and never the retired conditions (src/control/approval/scenario-policy.ts checks it before storing); a stored document written before may still have the retired conditions and no resultJudgement, which the reader drops and reads as null.

pageRecordId.description: The record id way of an API scenario (from the page after the save: a path pattern or an element).

formRecordId.description: PL-6a (plain UI design 8.1): the record id way of a FORM scenario: the record id patterns (one or more, tried in order on the URL after sending; LZ-3c: no upper count).

verificationOnly.description: PL-6a (the designer's decision (f)): true when the READ check definition is used only for the verification of this scenario (the READ check job does not read it). Absent means false.
